description:
We are a team of sixth-form students at Watford Grammar School for Boys, looking to apply our physics and coding skills to real world problems. We aim to develop an immersive game that simulates real astronaut missions using physics-based modelling systems, allowing missions to be tested and explored in virtual environments.

We are particularly looking for teammates with experience or an interest in 3D game development, Unity or Unreal Engine, 3D modelling, game design, and physics modeling.
